== Before you begin

NOTE: You need *root* access and `curl`.

[WARNING]
.Data loss
====
Upgrading from 1.x deletes the cache.

Back it up first.
====

== Install

. Download the package:
+
[source,bash]
----
curl -fsSL https://example.test/install.sh -o install.sh # <1>
sh install.sh --prefix /opt/lumen <2>
----
<1> Fetch the script.
<2> Run it.
. Start the service.
** Check the status.
** Read the logs.
. Done.
